reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Pleading contents and prohibition on dollar damage demands
headings.reviewNote: Requires a short, plain statement of facts and demand for relief while prohibiting specific dollar damage amounts except for jurisdictional thresholds.

headings.title: Discovery of claimed damages and trial use prohibition
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes discovery of total damages claimed while prohibiting opposing parties from using discovery responses at trial.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections and section 538.300 malpractice cross-reference on pleading contents, barring specific dollar demands except for jurisdiction, and non-use of damage discovery at trial.

headings.title: Pleading private statutes and statutory judicial notice
headings.reviewNote: Outlines method of pleading private statutes by title and publication reference, directing courts to take judicial notice thereof.

headings.title: Judicial notice of statutes and decisions of sister states
headings.reviewNote: Directs Missouri courts to take judicial notice of sister state public statutes and judicial decisions when foreign law is pleaded.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on pleading private statutes by title/reference and mandatory judicial notice of sister-state public statutes and judicial decisions.

headings.title: Deadlines for filing defendant answer
headings.reviewNote: Sets defendant answer deadline at 30 days after personal service, 30 days after filing return registered mail receipt, or 45 days after first publication of notice.

headings.title: Deadlines for answering cross-claims and replying to counterclaims
headings.reviewNote: Establishes twenty-day deadlines for filing answers to cross-claims and replies to counterclaims.

headings.title: Alteration of pleading deadlines by pretrial motions
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that filing pre-answer motions suspends responsive pleading deadlines until ten days after court action or amendment.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 3 subsections on answer, cross-claim/reply, and post-motion pleading deadlines; corrected subsection 1 note (30 days after mail receipt, 45 days after first publication).

headings.title: Written requirements and particularity of motions
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that applications for court orders be in writing stating grounds with particularity and relief sought, unless made during hearing or trial.

headings.title: Application of pleading formality rules to motions
headings.reviewNote: Extends pleading requirements concerning captions, signing, and formal structure to all written motions and filed papers.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on written motion particularity requirements and applying pleading formality rules to motions and papers.

headings.title: Grounds for pre-answer dismissal objections by motion
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates ten objections raisable by motion (jurisdiction, venue, process/service, cost security, capacity, pending action, misjoined claims, improper counterclaim/cross-claim).

headings.title: Supporting and opposing affidavits on motion objections
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes parties to support and controvert factual grounds for motion objections using affidavits pursuant to section 506.060.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on ten pre-answer motion objections (removed extratextual "failure to state a claim" from subsection 1 note) and supporting/opposing affidavits.

headings.title: Establishment of regular motion days and hearing sessions
headings.reviewNote: Directs trial courts to schedule regular, frequent times and places for hearing motions requiring notice and hearing.

headings.title: Determination of motions without oral argument
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court rules or orders providing for submission and disposition of motions on written statements without oral hearing.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on establishing regular motion hearing times and permitting determination of motions on written statements without oral hearing.

headings.title: Required redactions from public court pleadings and documents
headings.reviewNote: Mandates redaction of sensitive identifiers including Social Security numbers and account numbers from public court filings; note flags Cole County ruling.

headings.title: Submission of confidential information filing sheet
headings.reviewNote: Requires redacted information to be filed contemporaneously on a confidential case filing sheet exempt from public inspection.

headings.title: Record matching by financial institutions, insurers, and reporting agencies
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that lawfully authorized financial institutions, insurers, insurance support organizations, and consumer reporting agencies may use unique identifiers to match and validate court records.

headings.title: Supreme court rulemaking mandate for document redaction
headings.reviewNote: Directs the Missouri supreme court ("shall promulgate rules") to promulgate rules administering section 509.520 redaction requirements.

headings.title: Confidential case filing sheet for domestic relations petitions
headings.reviewNote: Mandates contemporaneous submission of a confidential filing sheet containing party and child identifiers in family law proceedings.

headings.title: Confidential case filing sheet for domestic relations responses
headings.reviewNote: Requires respondents in family law proceedings to contemporaneously file confidential sheets with full identifiers.

headings.title: Retention of full Social Security numbers on confidential court records
headings.reviewNote: Directs courts to retain full Social Security numbers of parties and children subject to custody or support on confidential records.

headings.title: Pleading inclusion of last four digits in lieu of full numbers
headings.reviewNote: Requires court filings to include only the last four digits of identifying numbers in lieu of complete identifiers.

headings.title: Clerk exemption from retroactive redaction of older records
headings.reviewNote: Relieves court clerks from duty to redact identifying numbers from court records filed prior to August 28, 2009, subject to section 452.430.

headings.title: Good cause release and child support enforcement agency access
headings.reviewNote: Permits court disclosure of confidential case sheet information for good cause and guarantees access to state child support enforcement agencies under chapter 454.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 10 subsections and Gross v. State (Cole County, Dec. 20, 2024) annotation; corrected subsection 3 to record matching and subsection 4 to mandatory supreme court rulemaking.
